name: Patrick's World
what: An explorable map of my projects and ideas, drawn as a survey atlas. A place to see what I have built and to build from.

features.name: The world model
features.note: An append-only event log and one pure function that derives the world at any date.

features.name: Terrain and town plans
features.note: The coast, rivers and relief, and town plans that grow outward and never rearrange.

features.name: The drawn sheet
features.note: The Canvas renderer: pencil, wash, hatching, shadows by storey.

features.name: The lettered surfaces
features.note: Cartouche, edition dial, survey notes, the Key, and the three ways to add to the world.

features.name: The GitHub survey
features.note: Reads my repositories and turns their history into the world's events.

features.name: Project understanding
features.note: An advisory reading of what each project is and where to pick it back up.

features.name: Build plans
features.note: What done means for a feature, and the reports that say how far along it is.

features.name: City definitions
features.note: A file in each repository that says what its city is, so the map stops guessing.

features.name: The founding questionnaire
features.note: A command to run in any repository: it reads the code, asks what it cannot see, and writes the city's definition.

features.name: The redrawn world
features.note: A complete redesign of how the world looks. After the definitions.

features.name: The companion and the first agent builder
features.note: A local process that keeps the log on disk and runs builders against a plan.
